description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 145. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 40 ki
Prerequisites: Instant Transmission, 1 Star in
Instant Kamehameha
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (100 feet)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
You form a Kamehameha before teleporting and
firing the beam.
You may teleport anywhere within 100 feet of your
location before rolling a Beam Attack Roll at a target
within 100 feet of you dealing 6d8 ki damage on a hit.
